name: FUN_DOCIO_AL_ARTIFACTS
description: This table contains transition data recognized and generated for each document, including elements such as logos, fingerprints, and predicted JSON outputs. These artifacts can be used for adaptive learning mapping.

columns.name: ARTIFACT_ID
columns.description: Training artifact identifier for Adaptive Learning.

columns.name: TRANSFORM_DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: The transform document identifier that the artifact is trained upon.

columns.name: PREDICT_JSON
columns.description: Predicted JSON result. The predicted JSON result is saved as reference data allowing adaptive learning to determine whether the trained value are are present for other documents.

columns.name: DOC_LOGO
columns.description: Indicates the logo information generated from the document.

columns.name: DOC_XML
columns.description: The structured XML content of the document.

columns.name: FINGERPRINT_ID
columns.description: Source fingerprint hash code for the transform document.

columns.name: ARTIFACT_LEARNING_MODE
columns.description: Learning mode of the Adaptive Learning training artifact.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
